headline: Google freezes open-source bug bounty program over AI slop
summary: Google suspended its Open Source Software Vulnerability Reward Program after a rise in invalid, AI-generated vulnerability reports. One outlet describes the freeze as specific to that program, while another frames it as bug bounty programs generally being overwhelmed by AI submissions.
